title: Shelf is nice.  Price is ridiculous!
text:
Shelf is nice. Price is ridiculous!. What is it with these $75 prices for a metal item. I wouldn't pay more than $35 for this set. I received the 2 tier and although it is nice, the price is insane. Definitely not worth $75

The top basket isn't level.
